export interface Box<T extends string = string> {
  readonly value: T;
  transform<U>(fn: (value: T) => U): U;
}
export type Wrapped<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: T[K] };
interface Result { count: number; name: string }
export function choose(input: string): string;
export function choose(input: number): number;
export function choose(input: string | number): string | number { return input; }
export function result(): Result { return { count: 1, name: 'one' }; }
export class Service<T extends string = string> {
  private secret = 1;
  static version: number = 1;
  readonly name: T;
  constructor(name: T) { this.name = name; }
  run(input: string): string;
  run(input: number): number;
  run(input: string | number): string | number { return input; }
}
